auth.signInSubtitle: Operator access to the KYC console
auth.sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
auth.passwordChanged: Password changed. Please sign in again with your new password.
auth.passwordMismatch: The two passwords do not match.
auth.passwordPolicy: At least 12 characters, with an upper-case letter, a lower-case letter, a digit and a symbol.
auth.lockedOut: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.

kyc.title: KYC Records
kyc.linkRevoked: The result link has been revoked.
kyc.linkRestored: The result link has been restored.
kyc.revokeLinkExplain: The customer's result page stops working immediately. Anyone holding the URL - including the customer - can no longer open it. The same URL works again if you restore the link.
kyc.coordinateWarning: The coordinates look inconsistent with the selected region.
kyc.deleteExplain: The record is retained for audit with its deletion time, and stops appearing in listings. This cannot be undone from here.
kyc.linkNotAvailable: The customer result link is only shown on a single record.

campaigns.title: Campaigns
campaigns.name: Name
campaigns.codeHint: Issued automatically when the campaign is created.
campaigns.endDateHint: Leave empty for a campaign that runs until it is deactivated.
campaigns.deleteExplain: This is refused if any KYC record is attributed to the campaign. Deactivate it instead to stop it while keeping those records attributed.
campaigns.deactivateExplain: The campaign stops accepting new registrations. Existing KYC records stay attributed to it, and you can activate it again at any time.
campaigns.hasRecords: This campaign has KYC records attributed to it and cannot be deleted. Deactivate it instead.

subscriptions.title: Subscription Plans
subscriptions.name: Name
subscriptions.deleteExplain: This is refused while any KYC record still references the plan. Set it inactive instead to retire it without affecting existing records.
subscriptions.priceHistoryNote: Changing this price does not change any existing KYC record: each keeps the price it was submitted at.

masterData.title: Master Data
masterData.name: Name
masterData.deleteProvinceExplain: This is refused while the province still has regions or KYC records.
masterData.deleteRegionExplain: This is refused while any KYC record still references the region.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.maxRangeNotice: The window may not exceed {days} days.
analytics.invertedRange: The start date must come before the end date.
analytics.trendDaysNotice: The daily trend covers at most {days} days.
analytics.revenueDeprecated: Pipeline value counts every record; completed value counts only completed work.

registrationLinks.title: Registration Links
registrationLinks.name: Name
registrationLinks.nameHint: Tells your links apart in this list. Customers never see it.
registrationLinks.campaignHint: Fixed when the link is created. Registrations through it are attributed automatically. Leave empty to let the customer type a campaign code instead.
registrationLinks.disableExplain: Customers opening it will be told it is closed. The URL is kept, so switching it back on restores the same link.
registrationLinks.campaignClosed: This link's campaign is inactive or outside its window, so the page stays closed.

apiClients.title: API Clients
apiClients.name: Name
apiClients.ipAllowlistHint: Bare IPs or CIDR ranges, comma separated. Leave empty to allow any address.
apiClients.expiresHint: Leave empty for a key that does not expire.
apiClients.secretWarning: This is the only time it will ever be shown. It is stored as a hash and cannot be recovered — if it is lost, the only remedy is another rotation.
apiClients.secretServerSide: This key is a server-side credential. Keep it in server configuration or a secret store, and never put it in a browser, a mobile app, or anything you distribute.
apiClients.revokeExplain: The key stops working on its next request and the client can never be reactivated. This is permanent.
apiClients.deactivateExplain: The key stops working immediately. Unlike revocation, this can be undone.
apiClients.rotateExplain: A new key is issued and shown once. The current key stops working immediately — there is no overlap window — so deploy the new key before rotating.
apiClients.cannotReactivate: This client has been revoked and cannot be reactivated.
apiClients.cannotRotateRevoked: This client has been revoked, so a new secret key cannot be issued for it.
apiClients.scopeCatalogue: Scopes decide what the key may do.
apiClients.scopeHint: Select every scope this key needs. Leave all unchecked for the default grant.

operators.title: Operators
operators.passwordNotice: The password is never shown again. Hand it to the operator directly and have them change it on first sign-in.
operators.roleHint: Admin is the regular operator role. Super Admin can also manage API clients and other operators.

empty.kycHint: Try changing your filters or search criteria.
empty.campaignsHint: Create a campaign to start attributing registrations to it.
empty.subscriptionsHint: Create a plan so registrations have something to select.
empty.provincesHint: Add a province, then add regions to it.
empty.regionsHint: Add a region to one of your provinces.
empty.registrationLinksHint: Create a link to start taking registrations from customers.
empty.apiClientsHint: Create a client to give an integration access to this API.
empty.operatorsHint: Try changing your search or filters.
empty.analytics: Nothing to report for this period

errors.title: Something went wrong
errors.400: The request was not valid. Please check the fields and try again.
errors.401: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
errors.403: You do not have permission to do that.
errors.404: That item no longer exists. It may have been deleted.
errors.409: This item was changed elsewhere, or the action conflicts with its current state.
errors.422: Some of the values are not valid.
errors.429: Too many requests. Please wait a moment and try again.
errors.500: The server ran into a problem. Please try again.
errors.503: The service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again shortly.
errors.network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.malformedResponse: The server replied, but the response could not be used. Please try again, and tell your administrator if it continues.
errors.sessionNotEstablished: The sign-in succeeded but the session could not be opened. Please try again, and tell your administrator if it continues.
errors.assetBlocked: Part of the app could not be downloaded. If you use an ad blocker or privacy extension, allow this site and reload.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.notFoundBody: The page you were looking for does not exist.
errors.forbiddenBody: Your account does not have permission to view this page.

validation.endBeforeStart: The end date must not come before the start date.
validation.futureDate: The date must be in the future.
